title: Exhibit exact fixed-shear resonances and cancelling words without claiming a full no-go
statement: For fixedp=e3,a=e1,k=(1,1024,0), take e=-(1,1024,0)/(1+1024^2). Then e.p=0,|e|=1/sqrt(1+1024^2)<rho=1/1024 and(a+e).k=0, so projected inviscid transport vanishes on the entire k+Zp ladder regardless of duration. The six-actuator cover supplies another good actuator, so this is not a full-family obstruction. Two exact-calibration/equal-phase pulses sharingp=e3 have U2(s2)U1(s1)=exp[i2pi*((s1*a1+s2*a2).xi)*H_xi]. For rationalpositive integrated strengths and rationaltransversepolarisations, a nonzero integer horizontalxi can be chosen perpendicular to s1*a1+s2*a2; on that entiresector the product is IDENTITY. Thus separate mixing estimates are not automatically multiplicative. Neither example rules out more sophisticated mixed-frequency words. Remaining full-target obligations are uniform polynomial scattering bounds, robust noncommuting composition/high-to-low-return control and a polynomial cumulative H3 bound across an input-dependent number of pulses. Full fixed-actuator positive and negative theorems remain unproved; the accepted2B5 theorem is unchanged.
